title: Ingo Swann sees a non-human woman at a supermarket

tellings.quote: like when you read like penetration by Ino Swan or something and he's like you know he's this a famous remote viewer who's like involved in the beginning of the Start program but then you read you're halfway into the book and he's like and then I'm at the supermarket and I see one

plain: A famous remote viewer named Ingo Swann, someone who claimed to see distant places with his mind and who was part of the start of a US government programme testing that skill, writes in his book Penetration that he saw a non-human being, a woman, at a supermarket. Jesse Michels tells this as something he has read, marvelling that halfway into a book about government psychic work Swann casually says he was at the supermarket and saw one.
